# EV Exec

> Premium airport transfers and private hire from Blackpool and the Fylde Coast, in a fully electric fleet (Tesla Model Y, Tesla Model Y Juniper, Skoda Enyaq). Rated 5.0 on Google.

EV Exec is an owner-run, licensed private hire business based on the Fylde Coast, Lancashire. It provides fixed-price airport transfers, corporate and executive travel, pre-booked private hire, long-distance transfers and event transfers. All drivers are licensed and enhanced DBS checked.

## Fixed airport prices (one way / return, from anywhere on the Fylde Coast, up to 4 passengers)
- Manchester Airport: £90 / £160 — https://evexec.co.uk/manchester-airport-transfer-blackpool
- Liverpool John Lennon Airport: £95 / £170 — https://evexec.co.uk/liverpool-airport-transfer-blackpool
- Leeds Bradford Airport: £135 / £250 — https://evexec.co.uk/leeds-bradford-airport-transfer-blackpool
- Birmingham Airport: £215 / £410 — https://evexec.co.uk/airport-transfer-birmingham-blackpool
- Newcastle Airport: £250 / £480
- Other UK airports: quoted on request — https://evexec.co.uk/quote
